(__voices.V.stop("fixture"),__voices.V.vol=0,__voices.V.speak({who:"mute",role:"command",text:"Command, this is Tower. Radio check. Over.",net:"uhf",cd:0,key:"mute"}),true)

expects.label: whole sentence uses installed Mark with natural synthesis cadence, no playback pitch shift
complete controller line reaches the real radio chain and squelch bed
normalized speech produces controlled output on the dedicated voice bus
pausing while synthesis is pending discards the late PCM without speaking
urgent wave-off stops the currently speaking controller
zero volume creates neither a speech source nor radio noise
complete-line and fallback playback remain serialized
all three installed actors are exposed to the listening room
